title: Bakery opening, recorded by Nadia with --me

reference.speaker: Others
reference.text: Thanks for joining. Today we plan the opening of the second bakery.

reference.speaker: Me
reference.text: Good. The landlord wants the signed lease back this week.

reference.speaker: Others
reference.text: Nadia, can you sign the lease and send it to the landlord by Friday?

reference.speaker: Me
reference.text: Yes, I will send the signed lease on Friday.

reference.speaker: Others
reference.text: We decided to open on the first Monday of March.

reference.speaker: Me
reference.text: Fine. Omar, can you order the new oven for the kitchen?

reference.speaker: Others
reference.text: Sure, I will order the new oven by tomorrow.

reference.speaker: Me
reference.text: And I will write the job post for two bakers.
